diff.title: Differences from this version to the current draft:
diff.same: The current draft is the same as this version.

editor.duplicated: Copy created. You are editing the copy.
editor.blocksHelp: Click a block to edit it. Blocks show on the site in this order.
editor.empty: This page has no blocks yet.
editor.tooMany: A page has at most {{count}} blocks.
editor.menuAdded: The page was added at the end of the menu. Change the order in Site → Navigation.
editor.menuRemoved: The page was removed from the menu.
editor.isHome: This is the home page of the site
editor.published: Page published. It is on the site now.
editor.unpublished: The page is no longer on the site.
editor.homeChanged: This is now the home page of the site.
editor.notLive: This page is not on the site yet. Click Publish when it is ready.
editor.pendingChanges: You have changes that are not on the site yet.
editor.noPublishPermission: Ask someone with permission to publish.

slug.invalid: Use only lowercase letters without accents, digits and hyphens. E.g. about-us
slug.reserved: This address is used by the system. Choose another one.

preview.title: Preview
preview.otherAddress: The site uses another address, so the preview opens in a new tab.
preview.failed: The preview could not be shown.

remove.title: Delete this page?
remove.description: The page goes to the trash and leaves the site. You can restore it from the trash.

problems.embed: The external form link was not recognized.
problems.link: This block has an invalid link.
problems.video: The video link was not recognized.
problems.email: Check the e-mail of this block.
problems.phone: Check the phone of this block.
problems.block: This block has text that is too long or too many items.

history.title: Page history
history.description: Every version sent for publication is kept. Restoring copies the version into the draft; it reaches the site only when you publish again.
history.empty: This page has no published versions yet.

schedule.description: The draft as it is now goes live at the chosen time. Later changes stay in the draft.
schedule.past: Choose a moment in the future.

review.sent: Sent for approval. The page goes live once it is approved.
review.blocked: The last publication did not happen: {{reason}}

reasons.approval_cancelled: the approval request was cancelled. Publish again.
reasons.approval_no_approver: nobody can approve it. Check the approval policy.
reasons.publication_requester_unauthorized: the person who asked can no longer publish.

languages.label: Language
languages.empty: This page has no {{language}} version yet. Meanwhile the site shows the main language content.

keybindings.scopeHelp: Shortcuts while building a site page

errors.block_embed_invalid: The external form link was not recognized. Use Google Forms, Typeform, Tally, Jotform or Calendly.
errors.block_email_invalid: Check the e-mail of the contact block.
errors.block_phone_invalid: Check the phone of the contact block.
errors.block_video_invalid: The video link was not recognized. Use a YouTube or Vimeo video.
errors.blocks_too_many_items: A block went over its item limit.
errors.page_slug_unavailable: No address could be chosen for the copy.
errors.slug_invalid: The address uses only lowercase letters without accents, digits and hyphens. E.g. about-us
errors.slug_reserved: This address is used by the system. Choose another one.
errors.plugin_field_unique_conflict: There is already a page with this address.
errors.entity_unique_conflict: There is already a page with this address.
errors.block_link_invalid: There is an invalid link. Use a site address starting with / or a full link starting with https://
errors.block_invalid: One of the blocks has a problem. Reload the page and try again.
errors.block_text_too_long: One of the texts is too long.
errors.blocks_too_many_blocks: The page has too many blocks. Split the content into more pages.
errors.blocks_too_many_buttons: A buttons block has at most 3 buttons.
errors.blocks_too_large: The page is too large. Split the content into more pages.
errors.publication_payload_too_large: The page is too large to publish. Split the content into more pages.
errors.page_not_published: Publish the page before using it as the home page.
